hooks.name: Enforce Bash Shell
hooks.description:
Before any shell command is executed, remind the agent to prefix the command with 'bash -c' to explicitly use bash as the shell.

Migration note: Tool categories were converted to the tool-name matcher `^(execute_bash|execute_pwsh|control_bash_process|control_pwsh_process|list_processes|get_process_output)$`, reconstructed from the built-in tool list. Confirm it covers the tools you meant, then enable the hook.

action.prompt: You MUST wrap the command with `bash -c "..."` to explicitly use bash as the shell. Rewrite the command as: bash -c "original command here". Do not run the command directly without the bash -c wrapper.
